There's a lot of overlap between Jason Wiles' (referred to as '韋·威爾遜' in the original translation) comedy Stick and Ted Lasso, and Apple just announced the show is returning for a second season, with The Pluribus star Rhea Seehorn joining the cast.

Stick Season 2 premieres November 4, Rhea Seehorn joins cast

After Ted Lasso season 3 finished airing, nobody knew if the show would be coming back. Luckily for Lasso fans, the show is indeed back, with season 4 currently airing.

However, during the hiatus, Apple TV released a new show very similar to Lasso.

Jason Wiles' (referred to as '韋·威爾遜' in the original translation) Stick premiered last summer and was immediately compared to Ted Lasso, also being hailed as a heartwarming sports comedy. Now, with Ted Lasso season 4 having just finished airing, Stick is also set to return.

Stick Season 2 will premiere its first two episodes on November 4 (Wednesday), with new episodes releasing weekly until December 30.

Here's a spoiler-free synopsis provided by Apple:

According to Apple's press release, the new season will see Santi continue his journey into the professional golf world, and Pryce will also return to the course.

Stick's strong ensemble cast will be back for season 2, which includes, in addition to Jason Wiles (referred to as '韋·威爾遜' in the original translation), Peter Dager, Marc Maron, Mariana Treviño, Lilli Kay, Judy Greer, and Timothy Olyphant.

The Pluribus star Rhea Seehorn will join the cast, playing Pryce's new golf coach. Other new additions to the cast include John Higgins, Billy Zane, Rex Linn, Sasha Alexander, and Missi Pyle.

You can watch Stick season 1 on Apple TV.

Are you a fan of Stick? Are you planning to watch season 2? Feel free to let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or you can get a discount through an Apple One bundle.
